answer_1.quote: We evaluate the models on open-ended Question Answering on the aforementioned prompts...

answer_2.quote: In addition to performing human evaluations, we build upon prior work on LLMs as multilingual evaluators to perform the same evaluations using LLMs as judges.

answer_3.quote: We also use an LLM (GPT-4-32K) for evaluating the battles as well as providing scores using the direct assessment metrics.

answer_4.quote: Each datapoint is evaluated by three human annotators and the majority vote is taken, yielding an overall of 3 × 30330 = 90K annotations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate responses based on linguistic acceptability, task quality, and hallucinations with specific rubrics.
